contacts.whyRelevant: Leads a three-person product team that ships the CLI and onboarding flows, and posts about hiring product interns.

Team launched a public roadmap page last month

sources.title: Example Labs team page

contacts.subject: Your CLI onboarding post + a PM intern ask
contacts.body:
Hi Priya,

Your post on guiding new users through CLI setup stuck with me, especially the step where you cut the config questions from seven to two.

I'm a final-year CS student who has been doing product work on the side. In my last project I mapped the signup funnel of a dev tool, ran 12 user interviews, and proposed two changes that the team shipped, lifting activation by 18%.

Would you be open to a 15-minute chat about product internships at Example Labs? My resume is attached.

Thanks,

contacts.name: Arjun Sample
contacts.title: Security Engineering Lead
contacts.whyRelevant: Runs the team building the product's threat-detection features and gave a talk on phishing detection.
hooks: Gave a talk on detecting phishing pages with lightweight ML
contacts.emailDetail: Unverified guess. Other patterns: arjun.sample@example.org, arjunsample@example.org
contacts.subject: Phishing detection: built something similar
contacts.body:
Hi Arjun,

I watched your talk on catching phishing pages with lightweight models. The point about using page structure instead of URLs alone matched what I saw in my own project.

I built PhishGuard, a browser extension that flags suspicious login pages using DOM features. It reached 94% precision on a 5,000-page test set and is used by about 200 students at my college.

I'm looking for a product or security internship. Would you have 15 minutes to tell me whether your team takes interns? My resume is attached.

Thanks,

contacts.subject: First product hire: an intern to start?
contacts.body:
Hi Mei,

Congrats on the seed round. You mentioned you're looking for your first product person, so I wanted to make a small pitch: start with an intern.

I've spent the past year doing hands-on product work: user interviews, writing specs, and shipping with engineers during a PM fellowship. I also won a 36-hour hackathon building an AI note-taking tool.

If useful, I'd love 15 minutes to hear what you need most right now. My resume is attached.

Thanks,
